stories.title: Borsa: Europa giù, salgono rendimenti titoli di stato, Milano -0,75%

en.title: Stock market: Europe down, government bond yields rise, Milan -0.75%
en.summary: European stock markets declined while yields on government bonds increased. U.S. markets weakened, crude oil and natural gas rose, and the spread exceeded 95 basis points.

stories.title: Ecco la bozza del dl scuola: minore allontanato dalla famiglia se i genitori non studiano l'italiano

en.title: School decree draft: minor separated from family if parents do not study Italian
en.summary: A draft school decree proposes free Italian language courses for parents whose children have serious linguistic difficulties. The draft includes a 30% cap on foreign students in first-year classes and a burqa ban.

stories.title: Bozza decreto scuola, multe fino a 1.000 euro per il burqa

en.title: School decree draft, fines up to 1,000 euros for burqa
en.summary: A school decree draft proposes penalties up to 1,000 euros for wearing burqas and establishes a 30% limit on foreign students in first-year classes.

stories.title: Il giudice riammette le testate ma bando di Trump resta: Politico, MsNow e Cnn fuori da Casa Bianca

en.title: Judge readmits news outlets but Trump's ban remains: Politico, MsNow and CNN excluded from White House
en.summary: A judge allowed three news networks to pursue legal action against their exclusion from White House premises, though the exclusion itself remains in effect. The three outlets had been banned after being accused by the president of spreading false news.

stories.title: Scuola, ecco il decreto: tetto a stranieri nelle classi prime, multe fino a 1000 euro per il burqa

en.title: School decree: cap on foreign students in first classes, fines up to 1000 euros for burqa
en.summary: The government approved a school decree establishing a ceiling on foreign students in initial classes and imposing fines for face-covering garments. The measure includes language support funding, Italian courses for parents, and provisions for student removal if parents refuse participation.

stories.title: Sinner verso il sì a Pechino. Alcaraz: "Mi manca giocare con Jannik"

en.title: Sinner heading toward yes for Beijing. Alcaraz: "I miss playing with Jannik"
en.summary: Optimism is growing about Jannik Sinner's participation in the ATP 500 tournament in the Chinese capital. Carlos Alcaraz, speaking from London, expressed his desire to compete against Sinner.

stories.title: Scuola, nel decreto multe fino a mille euro per chi ha il volto coperto. Tetto del 30% di stranieri

en.title: School, decree fines up to one thousand euros for covered face. 30% cap on foreign students
en.summary: A school decree imposes penalties ranging from 200 to 1000 euros for face-covering garments, applicable to both minors and their parents. The decree also establishes a maximum of 30 percent foreign students in classes.

stories.title: Tragedia al Colosseo, i genitori di Andrea Moretti tornano a Roma: "Diteci cosa è successo”

en.title: Tragedy at the Colosseum, Andrea Moretti's parents return to Rome: "Tell us what happened"
en.summary: The relatives of Andrea Moretti visited the morgue at Verano cemetery in Rome, seeking clarity about the circumstances of the incident that resulted in his death.

stories.title: Fisco, 9 milioni di italiani dichiarano zero. Il 30% paga quasi l’80% dell’Irpef

en.title: Tax: 9 million Italians declare zero income. 30% pay nearly 80% of income tax
en.summary: In Italy, approximately 9 million taxpayers report no income while contributing minimally to total income tax revenue. The wealthiest 30% of taxpayers account for nearly 80% of income tax collected.

stories.title: Meloni con Bianca Balti, Ghali e Anna Wintour alla cena di gala della Milano Fashion Week

en.title: Meloni with Bianca Balti, Ghali and Anna Wintour at Milan Fashion Week gala dinner
en.summary: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni attended the opening gala dinner of Milan Fashion Week alongside model Bianca Balti, musician Ghali, and Vogue's Global Editorial Director Anna Wintour. The event marked the first attendance by a prime minister at the fashion week in ten years.

stories.title: Michele Merlo, nessun risarcimento alla famiglia dell’ex cantante di Amici

en.title: Michele Merlo, no compensation awarded to family of former Amici singer
en.summary: The civil court in Vicenza rejected a compensation claim filed by the parents of Michele Merlo, a former Amici contestant, concluding the civil proceedings.

stories.title: Cia: “Mosca prepara attacchi dal mare in Italia, Francia e Spagna”. Roma: nessun pericolo. Rutte: “Siamo pronti”

en.title: CIA: "Moscow preparing sea attacks on Italy, France and Spain". Rome: no danger. Rutte: "We are ready"
en.summary: Intelligence agencies report Russian military preparations including drone operations over Moldova and attacks on Kyiv. Trump has invited Putin to the G20 while Zelensky proposed trilateral discussions.

stories.title: Hitachi Rail lancia il primo intercity elettrico a batteria. Trenitalia ne ha ordinati sei

en.title: Hitachi Rail launches first battery-electric intercity train. Trenitalia has ordered six
en.summary: Hitachi Rail introduced its first battery-electric intercity train, manufactured in Pistoia and Naples facilities. The train operates on both electrified lines and in battery mode with 100 kilometers of range on non-electrified routes, with Trenitalia placing an order for six units.

stories.title: Terra Madre Salone del Gusto, oltre mille eventi all’insegna della biodiversità

en.title: Terra Madre Salone del Gusto, over one thousand events celebrating biodiversity
en.summary: The Terra Madre Salone del Gusto event is organizing more than one thousand events focused on biodiversity, following a coordination meeting held in Pollenzo the previous year.

stories.title: Da Nestlé a Nespresso a Redion, così Bocconi fa lavorare (e laureare) detenuti

en.title: From Nestlé to Nespresso to Redion, how Bocconi works with (and graduates) prisoners
en.summary: Bocconi University's prison project provides employment and educational opportunities for incarcerated individuals through partnerships with major companies including Nestlé, Nespresso, and Redion.

stories.title: Advanced control solutions acquisisce Ksenia Security e Dea Security

en.title: Advanced control solutions acquires Ksenia Security and Dea Security
en.summary: Advanced control solutions, controlled by Investindustrial, has completed agreements to acquire Ksenia Security and Dea Security, two Italian companies, as part of consolidating Italian-made security capabilities.

stories.title: Data center, Mediterra investe oltre 20 milioni a Carini

en.title: Data center, Mediterra invests over 20 million in Carini
en.summary: Mediterra DataCenters plans to invest more than 20 million euros by the end of 2026 in a data center facility in Carini, as Palermo seeks to strengthen its position in Mediterranean digital infrastructure.
